svg.title: How to choose permissions when sharing a Google Calendar: distinguishing free/busy visibility from editing access
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to choose permissions when sharing a Google
Calendar: distinguishing free/busy visibility from
editing access
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-07
Find the calendar to share
On a computer, open calendar.google.com and find
the calendar to share under My calendars on the
left.
Add people to share with
Click More settings and sharing on the right
side of the calendar, then choose Add people and
groups under Shared with on the left.
Choose a permission: the three most
confusing options
First, See only free/busy shows only when
someone is busy; event names, locations, and
descriptions are not visible.
Confirm that the invitation email was
delivered
After choosing a permission, click Send to email
the person.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
